report_body.abstract: This lab investigated loop runtime profiling with nested iterations. Measurements were collected for N across 4 configurations using a controlled timing harness. The primary metric was wall-clock runtime in milliseconds for LoopA. At the largest setting, LoopA averaged 21.63 ms.
report_body.methodology: Implemented both loop variants, executed each size three times, and logged mean runtime to CSV.

tables.caption: Loop Runtime Profiling with Nested Iterations — measured results

report_body.plot_code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
x = [1000.0, 10000.0, 100000.0, 1000000.0]
plt.figure(figsize=(6, 4))
plt.plot(x, [1.23, 1.03, 2.77, 21.63], marker='o', label='LoopA')
plt.plot(x, [1.26, 1.25, 16.55, 14.67], marker='o', label='LoopB')
plt.xlabel('N')
plt.ylabel('Runtime (ms)')
plt.title('Loop Runtime Profiling with Nested Iterations')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('plot.png', dpi=300)
report_body.discussion: Results show how LoopA scales with N. A unit mismatch was present in the raw log and normalized to milliseconds before analysis. Trends align with expected algorithmic or system behaviour for this exercise. Variance across trials was low enough for comparative conclusions.
report_body.conclusion: The experiment confirmed expected behaviour for Loop Runtime Profiling with Nested Iterations. All tabulated values are grounded in the uploaded raw log after anomaly normalization.

report_body.abstract: This OS lab compared CPU scheduling via cpu scheduling: fcfs vs sjf vs round robin. Average waiting and turnaround times were collected for 4 policies.
report_body.methodology: Fed identical process burst sets to each scheduler and recorded waiting/turnaround metrics.
report_body.plot_code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
x = [0, 1, 2, 3]
plt.figure(figsize=(6, 4))
plt.plot(x, [140.2, 141.7, 58.8, 32.5], marker='o', label='AvgWaiting')
plt.xlabel('AlgorithmIndex')
plt.ylabel('Waiting (ms)')
plt.title('CPU Scheduling: FCFS vs SJF vs Round Robin')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('plot.png', dpi=300)
report_body.discussion: SJF typically reduced waiting time versus FCFS in these traces. A millisecond/second unit mismatch was normalized. Round Robin context-switch overhead was visible in the counters.
report_body.conclusion: Scheduling results match expected OS theory for the provided workload.
